payload.summary: Historical FRANK code yields reusable state/body/goal mechanisms plus concrete lost-update, concurrency, persistence, drift-safety and lifecycle failure cases. The 70-turn benchmark is reusable as scaffolding but causally confounded and must not be treated as component-level architecture proof.

branch_feedback.frank: Preserve typed persistent personality/goals/body/proprioception semantics, but eliminate divergent process-local semantic caches. One-module FRANK should make transition identity/replay explicit.
branch_feedback.claycode: State transitions need first-class version/CAS or deterministic event identities so stale writers cannot overwrite newer state; lifecycle/resource effects need explicit semantics.
branch_feedback.gwt: Historical workspace/proprioception/attention mechanisms are architecture candidates, not GWT evidence by naming. Reuse longitudinal prompt battery only in matched causal ablations.
branch_feedback.emergenz: Do not promote the 70-turn full-vs-bare comparison as emergence evidence; multiple simultaneous interventions confound causal attribution.
branch_feedback.claygraph: Historical persistent self/world/body state and deleted-artifact chronology require temporal/provenance edges; head-only ingestion loses material history.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: Lost-update EPQ bug plus non-atomic/stale config bugs support one authoritative logical state plane with transactions/CAS, restart idempotence and history-preserving semantics.
branch_feedback.harness: Convert SOMA audit bugs into mandatory regression families: TOCTOU, thread cancellation, atomic write, stale config, duplicate restart work, key conservation, zero-baseline drift, resource cleanup and randomized training order.
branch_feedback.clay: Historical mechanisms are reusable substrates; historical service/room metaphors are not mandatory future architecture. Integrate invariants and negative results, not old topology wholesale.

payload.immediate_test_request: Harness should materialize PF-L0-FAIL-005 as executable regression cases before H1/H2 freeze.
payload.evidence_status_rule: Historical code/commits retain historical evidence class; repeated worker agreement does not upgrade them.
